descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S02 iOS and Android store builds: no provider key in the packaged app

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1a No long-lived provider API key or credential (AWS, OpenAI, Google Vertex service account, Deepgram, SES) is present anywhere in client code: the web bundle and its served source maps, the iOS and And … (UAT OAT-05 step 1; TFA-94700 AC 5; TFA-94700 description ('No API keys client-side … UAT OAT-05 step 1'); TFA-94423 AC 1)

Test design technique: Device (device) — Look at the layout and gestures at phone size or on a real device (iPhone / Pixel).

Given The TestFlight IPA and the Play internal AAB/APK that pilot physicians will install (build numbers from the 3.1 run record)

When Unpack both. Run the S01 patterns over the bundled web assets (public/), capacitor.config.json, Info.plist, AndroidManifest.xml, res/values/*.xml, and native plugin configs. Check that no GoogleService-Info.plist or google-services.json carries an API key.

Then No provider key or credential in either package. The native layer holds only the Convex URLs.

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): UAT OAT-05 step 1 and TFA-94700 AC 5 ('anywhere in the app'), on iOS and Android. Any match is a Fail, quoted with the platform, file and key type (value masked).

Where it ran: local code-review (judged by reading the code); test method STATIC · Static check (build output / scan); lane planned in the matrix: manual (manual)

S02 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-05.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16/17 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane code-review.

Test method: STATIC · Static check (build output / scan); secondary: CONFIG · Config check — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: code-review.
